personalities.name: Hikaru Nakamura
personalities.description: American chess grandmaster and Twitch/YouTube streamer known for bullet chess and reactions to Magnus Carlsen.

personalities.name: Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
personalities.description: American politician, environmental lawyer, and vaccine skeptic; known for his raspy voice and conspiracy-adjacent views.

personalities.name: Sherlock Holmes
personalities.description: Fictional consulting detective created by Arthur Conan Doyle; famously arrogant, deductive, violin-playing, cocaine-using.

personalities.name: Demis Hassabis
personalities.description: Co-founder and CEO of Google DeepMind; former chess prodigy and game designer; Nobel laureate (chemistry, 2024).

personalities.name: Stephen Curry
personalities.description: NBA superstar point guard for the Golden State Warriors; greatest 3-point shooter of all time; relatively small for the NBA.

personalities.name: Sam Altman
personalities.description: CEO of OpenAI; former Y Combinator president; known for prepper hobbies, a soft voice, and his board-firing-then-rehiring saga.

personalities.name: Lisa Manoban
personalities.description: Thai rapper and singer; member of K-pop group BLACKPINK; solo artist, fashion icon, and Celine ambassador.

personalities.name: Alex Honnold
personalities.description: American rock climber famous for free-solo (no ropes) ascents, including El Capitan; subject of the documentary Free Solo.

personalities.name: Jon Stewart
personalities.description: American comedian and political commentator; longtime host of The Daily Show; returned in 2024.

personalities.name: Dario Amodei
personalities.description: Co-founder and CEO of Anthropic; former OpenAI VP of research; known for long essays about AI safety and 'Machines of Loving Grace'.

personalities.name: Pamela Anderson
personalities.description: Canadian-American actress and Playboy fixture; Baywatch icon; vegan activist; survived a notorious 1990s sex-tape leak with Tommy Lee.

personalities.name: Whitney Cummings
personalities.description: American stand-up comedian; co-creator of 2 Broke Girls; producer and host of the Good for You podcast.

personalities.name: Donald Trump
personalities.description: American real-estate mogul, reality-TV host (The Apprentice), and 45th + 47th U.S. President; famous for his hair and ego.

personalities.name: James Franco
personalities.description: American actor and serial degree-collector (Yale, UCLA, NYU); known for 127 Hours, Spider-Man, and a perpetual half-asleep gaze.

personalities.name: Jonah Hill
personalities.description: American actor and writer (Superbad, Moneyball, The Wolf of Wall Street); two-time Oscar nominee; Hollywood lifer with a fluctuating waistline.

personalities.name: Rob Lowe
personalities.description: American actor; Brat Pack heartthrob in The Outsiders and St. Elmo's Fire; star of The West Wing and Parks & Recreation; survived a 1988 sex-tape scandal.

personalities.name: Nikki Glaser
personalities.description: American stand-up comedian and roast performer; podcaster; widely praised set at the 2024 Roast of Tom Brady; hosted the 2026 Golden Globes.

personalities.name: Blake Griffin
personalities.description: Former NBA All-Star forward (Clippers, Pistons, Nets, Celtics); famed dunker; once engaged to Kendall Jenner.

personalities.name: Caitlyn Jenner
personalities.description: Olympic decathlon gold medalist (as Bruce Jenner, 1976); reality-TV star (Keeping Up with the Kardashians); came out as transgender in 2015.

personalities.name: Alec Baldwin
personalities.description: American actor (30 Rock, Glengarry Glen Ross, The Hunt for Red October); SNL Trump impersonator; involved in the 2021 Rust on-set shooting.
